summary: The agent implements a solid baseline LightGBM regression model with cross-validation and date-based feature engineering. However, it completely relies on the model to handle missing values (FM03) and fails to evaluate performance using the specified RMSE metric (FM15). Most critically, the agent ignores the temporal nature of the dataset during splitting (FM05) and explicitly engineers features from future events (like repayment and closing dates) to predict the original principal amount, resulting in massive target leakage.
